title: Compare complete PLY parser values and progress in actual browser Wasm
scope: Safe private raw-PLY codec plus current-SHA source/native/browser comparisons for all 60 ASCII and 167 binary cases; explicit million-vertex runtime budget exclusion, retaining all native and existing browser inputs.
acceptance: Actual Chrome executes independent raw inputs only; exact complete PLY output/progress/refusals match original and native, including IEEE bits.
No source outputs enter Rust; all raw outputs retained before assertions; malformed/changed output and missing/stale sidecars fail.
Existing 114 browser cases and their tolerances remain unchanged; one new workload exclusion is explicit and cannot hide a previously passing browser case.
open_items: Specified in oracle/PLY-WASM.md; runtime implementation and actual Chrome evidence pending.
